packets.instruction_payload: Complete the synthetic task directly using only the supplied task evidence. Do not add recursive inquiry unless needed for correctness.
packets.closure_rule_payload: Stop after a sufficient answer to the stated task is produced.

packets.instruction_payload: Inspect the synthetic task recursively: identify anomalies, test at least one competing explanation, and preserve unresolved uncertainty.
packets.closure_rule_payload: Stop when the main anomaly and one competing explanation have been assessed or when evidence is insufficient.

packets.instruction_payload: Apply the reciprocal epistemic protocol: reformulate the problem, separate provenance, seek counterevidence, assess implementability, and state the claim ceiling.
packets.closure_rule_payload: Stop after counterevidence is checked and the strongest supportable claim ceiling is recorded.

packets.instruction_payload: Apply the reciprocal epistemic protocol and consult the bound repository-history references only when they are relevant to the synthetic task.
packets.closure_rule_payload: Stop after relevant history is checked, irrelevant retrieval is avoided, and the claim ceiling is recorded.

packets.instruction_payload: Apply bounded inquiry and stop at the predeclared closure threshold without extending the scope.
packets.closure_rule_payload: Stop exactly when one anomaly check, one counterevidence check, and one uncertainty statement are complete.
